physicalNotes: Radius 0.68 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Hellier et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-145 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract): 473,076 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 4900 +/- 150 K from Hellier et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-145 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
